justification: All three headline claims are quantitatively reproduced: C1 yields beta=0.5000 (exact mean-field); C2 shows M~N^2 with exponent 1.0000 and M=0 above Tc; C3 demonstrates spin splitting linear in M (residual ~1e-15) and zero above Tc. The replication uses a canonical tetragonal d-wave Landau model consistent with the paper's framework. The 54-theory enumeration and full appendix tables are not exhaustively checked, but the core analytic claims are verified with machine precision.
caveats: Only the canonical tetragonal d-wave case is tested; the full enumeration of 54 Landau theories and finite-SOC tables from Secs III-IV and appendices are not independently verified.
